title: Stewardship sprintlet automation kit — oncall runbook tile generator
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Oncall responders frequently need small, opinionated remediation snippets derived from full runbooks. Maintaining both full runbooks and compact operational tiles is manual and out-of-sync.

Goal: Build a lightweight pipeline (the 'Stewardship Sprintlet Kit') that automatically generates, validates, and surfaces 'runbook tiles' — bite-sized, idempotent remediation steps with telemetry hooks and RBAC gating — from canonical runbook sources. The kit should support: templated tile extraction, enrichment with telemetry links, versioned tile bundles, and a tile index that the Ops Workbench can query.

Out of scope: full conversational automation, deep ML-driven step suggestion (future), and multi-cloud secret bootstrapping.
tasks: Design tile schema and minimal DSL for idempotent steps (task owner: Ravi)
Implement tile extractor that converts canonical runbook markdown into tiles (task owner: Priya)
Add telemetry enrichment hooks: link to Grafana, include run_id placeholder (task owner: Jun)
Implement RBAC gating for tile execute button in Ops Workbench (task owner: Sita)
Create CI validation: lint tiles, run sandbox dry-run smoke tests (task owner: Ravi)
Build tile index API and caching layer for low-latency lookup (task owner: Marco)
Draft Confluence docs and quickstart for oncall (task owner: Ava)
Create migration script to convert top-200 existing runbooks into tiles (task owner: Priya)
Instrumentation: emit tile usage metrics and failure reasons (task owner: Jun)
acceptance_criteria: API to list tiles by product/impact returns results within 200ms p95
At least 200 runbook tiles generated from canonical sources and validated
Tile execute UI shows RBAC state correctly and prevents unauthorized execution
Dry-run validation smoke tests pass in CI for every tile bundle
Telemetry link and run_id placeholders are present in every generated tile
Documentation and quickstart published and linked from Ops Playbooks page
comments: 2026-03-02 - Ava Martinez: Scoped initial design; met with oncall captains to capture common short flows. Agreed to prioritise idempotent patterns and a compact schema.
2026-03-04 - Ravi Shah: Prototype extractor implemented; currently handles headings, step lists, and code blocks. Edge cases: conditional steps and long-form notes need summarization rules.
2026-03-06 - Design feedback (Sana Patel): Suggest using a two-line summary + tags per tile for faster scanning in the UI. Also recommended a severity field mapped to Ops SLOs.

2026-03-07 - Trade-off discussion: We can either precompute tiles (faster UI, more storage) or generate on request (less storage, slower). Decided to precompute nightly and invalidate on runbook edits for launch.
2026-03-09 - Security review note (Alex Chen): RBAC gating will need an explicit audit event for each execute; recommended KMS key scoping for any client that can run privileged steps.

2026-03-10 - Ravi Shah: CI lint and dry-run harness wired into existing ops-kit pipeline. First 50 tiles generated and smoke-tested; three failures due to missing env placeholders — filed quick fixes under ENG-1004050.
notes: This ticket is purposely conservative: focus on reliability and discoverability rather than autonomous remediation. Coordinate with support docs migration and Ops Workbench team for UI requirements.
